title: Plumbing Estimate Template: Fill In, Download PDF, Word, Excel
description: Write a plumbing estimate in your browser with scope, exclusions, valid-until date and deposit. No sign-up. US price ranges for bigger plumbing jobs, with sources.
lede_html: Fill in the form to price a plumbing job before you start, then download it as a PDF, Word or Excel file. No account. The sample is a bathroom rough-in. Replace it with your job.

sample.scope: Move drain and supply lines for a new vanity and shower. Pressure test. Patch access holes to rough drywall.
sample.exclusions: Tile, paint, fixtures chosen by the owner, and repair of hidden damage found after opening the wall.
sample.terms: Any change in scope needs a written change order before the work.

must_show.heading: What a plumbing estimate should say
must_show.intro_html: The estimate tells the customer what you will do, what you will not do, the price, and how long the price holds. Hidden pipe work is the usual source of a price dispute, so say how you treat it.
must_show.why_label: Why it matters before the wall is open
rows: The customer can compare your price with another bid on the same work.
Tile, drywall finish and fixtures are common items that a customer assumes are in the price.
Say what happens when you find corroded pipe or a bad vent behind the wall.
Name the model, or give an allowance and say who pays the difference.
Say who pulls the permit and whether the fee is in the price.
Copper and water heater prices move. A date protects your margin.
Link payments to steps such as rough-in passed and final connection.

example.heading: Filled example: tank to tankless swap
example.intro_html: A second job with sample prices, to show how a replacement estimate reads. These are not price advice.

items.d: Remove the 40 gal tank, cap old lines

line_items.heading: Larger plumbing jobs and typical prices
line_items.intro_html: Tap Add to put a line on the form. The range comes from the source in the same row. The price that the button adds is a sample inside that range, not a price recommendation.

rules.heading: Rules to check before you send a plumbing estimate

items.title: Who may do the work
items.html: In Texas, anyone except a responsible master plumber needs the proper license, registration or endorsement, and licensed supervision. Put your number on the estimate when your state asks.

items.title: Permit rules are local
items.html: Permit rules are local. Kirkland, Washington, asks for a mechanical permit on a gas water heater swap and a plumbing permit when you move water piping, so check each city.

items.title: Sales at the customer home
items.html: A buyer may cancel a home sale until midnight of the third business day under the FTC Cooling-Off Rule. The rule has exceptions, such as a repair visit that the buyer asked for. Ask a lawyer about your case.

faq.q: Is a plumbing estimate the same as a quote?
faq.a: People use both words. A fixed price with a scope acts like a quote. Write "estimate" and state how the price can change, or write "fixed price" if it will not change.

faq.q: Should I itemize parts on an estimate?
faq.a: Itemize when the customer compares bids. Show one lot price when your supplier cost changes often. Keep labor apart either way, so that you can use the tax choice on the form.

faq.q: How long should a plumbing estimate stay valid?
faq.a: Choose a date that matches how fast your supplier prices change. Thirty days is common in the samples on this page. The form prints the date from the number of days you enter.

faq.q: Can I charge for writing an estimate?
faq.a: Say so before the visit. A paid diagnostic visit is a separate charge from a free written price. Credit it to the job if you promised that.
